title: 26 undertaken, was in respect of ‘Robbery’ and the lowest was in respect of ‘Murder’ (4.0%). Out of the total number of cases which were disposed of by the police during the year, charge sheets were laid, in 37.2% of cases. The highest percentage of cases in which charge sheets were laid out of the cases disposed of by the police was in respect of ‘Murder’ (65.9%) and the lowest in respect of ‘Robbery’ (22.3%). The pattern of disposal of cases by the police under the various heads is more or less the same as in the previous years. The number of cases pending investigation at the end of the year increased from 153044 in 1969 to 182266 in 1970.
